description: This Java class 'BookUtils' provides utility methods for handling 'Book' objects in a book-tracking application, including combining title and series information.

classes.name: BookUtils
classes.description: A final utility class containing static methods to operate on Book objects, including combining title and series info.

methods.name: combineTitleAndSeries
methods.description: Returns a string combining the book's title and series position if available.

methods.name: addSeriesToTitle
methods.description: Creates an Optional string that appends the series position to the book's title.

methods.name: bookHasSeriesPosition
methods.description: Checks if the book has a non-null, positive series position.
